description: This file generates and displays a list view for a module in the vtiger CRM system, including handling custom views, permissions, sorting, pagination, and search functionalities.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Class handling custom view management, including view permissions and query modifications.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering views.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab category for the current module.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks and returns available buttons for the module.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for specific actions on the module.

methods.name: getTranslatedString
methods.description: Returns translated string for a given key.

methods.name: getUserslist
methods.description: Retrieves list of users for ownership change.

methods.name: getGroupslist
methods.description: Retrieves list of groups for ownership change.

methods.name: getWhereCondition
methods.description: Generates SQL WHERE condition based on search criteria.

methods.name: getListQuery
methods.description: Constructs the base SQL query for listing records.

methods.name: getTableNameForField
methods.description: Returns the table name for a given field in the module.

methods.name: fixPostgresQuery
methods.description: Adjusts query syntax for PostgreSQL compatibility.

methods.name: mkCountQuery
methods.description: Creates a COUNT query for pagination.

methods.name: ListViewSession::getRequestCurrentPage
methods.description: Determines the current page number for list view pagination.

methods.name: VT_getSimpleNavigationValues
methods.description: Provides navigation info for pagination controls.

methods.name: getRecordRangeMessage
methods.description: Generates message indicating current record range displayed.

methods.name: getTableHeaderSimpleNavigation
methods.description: Generates HTML for pagination navigation.

methods.name: getListViewHeader
methods.description: Retrieves headers for list view columns.

methods.name: getListViewEntries
methods.description: Retrieves list view entries (rows) for display.

methods.name: getSearchListHeaderValues
methods.description: Retrieves header values for search filters.

methods.name: AlphabeticalSearch
methods.description: Generates alphabetical search options.

methods.name: getAdvSearchfields
methods.description: Retrieves fields available for advanced search.

methods.name: getcriteria_options
methods.description: Provides options for search criteria.

methods.name: getMergeFields
methods.description: Retrieves fields for merging or available fields.
